description: Returns the account-level shipping settings: services[] (delivery countries, delivery times, rate tables and carrier rates), warehouses[] and an etag. Read-only by design: the API's only write is shippingSettings:insert, a FULL REPLACE of every service — too dangerous for a tool; use raw_request if you really need it.

account.description: Merchant Center account ID (digits, e.g. "123456"). Omit to use the GOOGLE_MERCHANTS_ACCOUNT_ID default.

name: get_shipping_settings
title: Get shipping settings
